meta.notes: A dialog tag gives one name to several dialog ids. values lists ids or other tags (written #namespace:path); set replace to true only to wipe what other packs put in a tag of the same id. Dialogs in the vanilla tags #minecraft:pause_screen_additions and #minecraft:quick_actions get a button on the pause screen or open with the quick actions key; a tag of your own such as #msm_examples:help_screens is for grouping and reuse, for example in a dialog list.
